note: Booking agent (decision docs/decisions/2026-11-12-book-agent.md). Same server path as the ask agent (voice-agent/task-call/): our server places the Twilio call and connects it with register-call, passing the variables compiled from the approved booking card (server/messaging/src/taskCalls/payload.ts). Created by server/messaging/scripts/setup-task-call-agent.mjs --agent book; the server's drift check compares the live agent with TASK_BOOK_AGENT_SPEC in server/messaging/src/taskCalls/agentSpec.ts, which voice_agent_spec.py keeps in step with this folder.

variables.doddy_opening_line: AI disclosure + the booking question, spoken word for word (server-built)
variables.doddy_question: the booking question (server-built from the booking)
variables.doddy_principal: the user's first name in the genitive
variables.doddy_goal: not in the prompt since 12 Nov 2026: a fixed server-built sentence, never the person's goal, kept only for live prompts that still name it
variables.doddy_booking: the approved booking: name, day, time, service or number of people (server-built)
variables.doddy_booking_confirm_line: the one sentence that accepts exactly that booking (server-built)
variables.doddy_facts: only the facts the user ticked, one per line
variables.doddy_attempt: attempt id for matching the post-call webhook; not used in the prompt
